competitiveTarget: Beat Zillow / Redfin / Windermere regional market entry pages. KB kinetic-brutalist chrome, live region stat band + yearSeries overlay chart, per-city active-count tiles, market FAQ plus FAQPage JSON-LD, Dataset JSON-LD for AI citability. KbMarketHud data-credibility block that no aggregator site carries.
note: Region report page at /housing-market/central-oregon. KB conversion — Phase 9, docs/KB_CONVERGENCE_ROADMAP.md. KbMarketData built from regionPulse (market_pulse_live geo_type='region') + completePriceMonths (market_stats_cache) via buildYearSeries. Per-city tiles from ONE getMarketPulseCitySnapshots call. FAQBlock emits FAQPage JSON-LD (includeJsonLd=true). Dataset + WebPage JSON-LD via MetadataBlock.

requiredComponents.name: MetadataBlock
requiredComponents.section: BreadcrumbList + WebPage + Dataset JSON-LD (G34 AI-citability). dateModified equals regionPulse.refreshedAt from market_pulse_live, never hardcoded. variableMeasured from buildMarketFaq datasetVariables.

requiredComponents.name: KbNav
requiredComponents.section: KB chrome navigation — top of page.

requiredComponents.name: KbBreadcrumb
requiredComponents.section: Visual breadcrumb: Home > Housing market > Central Oregon. No JSON-LD (MetadataBlock owns the BreadcrumbList).

requiredComponents.name: SmoothScrollProvider
requiredComponents.section: Lenis smooth scroll wrapper around all KB sections.

requiredComponents.name: KbHero
requiredComponents.section: Region hero — eyebrow 'Central Oregon · Oregon', titleTop 'Central Oregon', titleBottom 'market report', data-driven lede from regionPulse (active count, median list price, months of supply verdict).

requiredComponents.name: KbMarketHud
requiredComponents.section: Region KbMarketData. §0-traced: active/closed30/medianList/daysToPending/monthsSupply from regionPulse; trend from completePriceMonths last 13; byTown from citySnapshots; yearSeries from buildYearSeries(completePriceMonths, 5). eyebrow 'Central Oregon · The market'.

requiredComponents.name: KbExploreTowns
requiredComponents.section: Per-city active-count tiles from ONE getMarketPulseCitySnapshots call. Each item links to /housing-market/<city-slug>. eyebrow 'Central Oregon', title 'Cities and towns', sectionId='cities'.

requiredComponents.name: FAQBlock
requiredComponents.section: Region market FAQ from buildMarketFaq, 4 to 5 Q&A pairs. includeJsonLd=true auto-emits FAQPage JSON-LD (G34). tone='muted'.

requiredComponents.name: KbSell
requiredComponents.section: Seller conversion block fed by regionPulse: medianListPrice, medianDaysToPending, closedLast30Days. eyebrow 'Sell in Central Oregon'.

requiredComponents.name: KbFooter
requiredComponents.section: Full sitemap close. towns prop = cityTowns array (same KbTownItem[] as KbExploreTowns).

optionalComponents.name: KbArticles
optionalComponents.section: Recent blog posts from getRecentBlogPosts({ limit: 3 }). Renders null when empty — not a ship-blocker.

layoutComponents.name: SiteHeader
layoutComponents.section: Hidden for kb-root pages via HideChrome in app/layout.tsx

layoutComponents.name: SiteFooter
layoutComponents.section: Hidden for kb-root pages via HideChrome in app/layout.tsx

deferredComponents.name: KbFeatured
deferredComponents.reason: Region scope has no single featured-listing feed; deferred until a curated featured-region DAL function exists.

deferredComponents.name: KbListingMap
deferredComponents.reason: Region-level map with per-city aggregation deferred; city pages own the map tile.

deferredComponents.name: KbTicker
deferredComponents.reason: Ticker requires listing tiles with addresses; the region page has no per-listing feed.

deferredComponents.name: KbTestimonials
deferredComponents.reason: Deferred from region page for now; lives on city/community pages.

deferredComponents.name: KbTeam
deferredComponents.reason: Deferred from region page for now; lives on city/community pages.

deferredComponents.name: KbAbout
deferredComponents.reason: No region 'about' paragraphs DAL function yet; city pages own the about section.

required.note: Primary AI-citability signal. dateModified must equal regionPulse.refreshedAt from market_pulse_live geo_type='region'. Each variableMeasured value must equal the on-screen number (CLAUDE.md §0). Emitted only when datasetVariables.length > 0 AND refreshedAt is present.
buildMarketFaq is the single source for FAQ items, FAQPage JSON-LD, and Dataset variableMeasured — the three surfaces cannot diverge.

dataLayer.getMarketPulse: lib/data/market/getMarketPulse.ts, market_pulse_live geo_type='region' geo_slug='central-oregon' property_type='A', 10 to 15 min freshness. Used for KbHero lede, KbMarketHud stats, KbSell data, and Dataset dateModified.
dataLayer.getPriceHistory: lib/data/market/getPriceHistory.ts, market_stats_cache region rows, interval='monthly', 60 months. completePriceMonths drops the in-progress current month. Used for KbMarketHud trend + yearSeries.
dataLayer.getMarketPulseCitySnapshots: lib/data/market/getMarketPulseSnapshot.ts, market_pulse_live city rows for CITY_LABELS, property_type='A'. ONE call replaces legacy ~12-call fan-out. Used by KbExploreTowns active counts and KbMarketHud byTown.
dataLayer.getRecentBlogPosts: lib/data/blog/getRecentBlogPosts.ts, blog_posts published newest first, limit=3. Used by KbArticles (optional).
dataLayer.buildYearSeries: lib/kb/year-series.ts. Groups completePriceMonths into up to 5 calendar-year lines for the KbMarketHud year-over-year overlay chart.
dataLayer.buildMarketFaq: lib/site/market-faq.ts. Single source for FAQBlock items, FAQPage JSON-LD, and Dataset variableMeasured.
dataLayer.note: All DAL functions imported from @/lib/data (G8 compliant). No @/app/actions/* imports. No raw .from() calls.
